The '''Peacekeepers''' were a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] faction that split from the mainstream [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> dedicating themselves to nonviolence and contemplation. They produced many writings, the last of which were their greatest. These final writings were hidden in a [[Hidden chamber|chamber]] beneath the [[plaza fountains]] of their [[Peacekeepers' temple|temple]].<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> By 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the tranquil Peacekeeper temple was deserted but had been rediscovered.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to investigate the temple. Exploring it, the companion discovered the hidden chamber beneath the [[Water/Legends|fountains]] and delivered the last writings of the Peacekeepers to the individual who sent them.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Peacekeepers were mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "The Peacekeepers" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" /> The mission was initially only available to Galactic Republic players<ref name="TORhead">{{WebCite|url=http://www.torhead.com/crew-mission/bVJSnsn/the-peacekeepers|text=The Peacekeepers|work=torhead.com|archivedate=20150317013950}}</ref> though both that restriction and the information about the mission's outcome are no longer a part of the game.<ref name="The Peacekeepers" />
